news.headline: Five suspects arrested in explosives case near UK airbase were British nationals
news.summary: Five suspects arrested by British police on suspicion of terrorism and explosives ​offenses after white vans drove towards an airbase used by US forces were all British nationals from London in their early 20s, police said on Monday. France 24 Benedicte Paviot has more.

news.headline: German Town Votes to Stop Adding Memorials Outside Homes of Slain Jews
news.summary: Councilors in an eastern German town voted to stop installing memorial plaques outside homes of Holocaust victims, saying they would instead build a memorial at a cemetery.
